description: Source code for E2SM-CCC control action executor related to DU configuration, including class definitions, control action support checks, and execution logic for RRM policy ratio control.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for control action executors, including action ID and name retrieval, and control action definition.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_o_rrm_policy_ratio_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing support check and execution for O-RRMPolicyRatio control actions.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the action ID associated with the control action.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the control action structure.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Returns the control action definition (currently empty).

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if the control request is supported based on RIC style type and control message structure.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the control action, converting request to DU config, validating, logging, and applying configuration.
